critical_code_review_comments: Same cache-key concern from iteration_8 still applies: server cache is keyed only on `category`, so a cached count=10 result serves count=4 callers via slice (fine), but if someone later requests count=10 while a count=4 doc is cached, they silently get 4. Not a regression — pre-existing.
Prefetch of 4 other categories at 400ms after first render still fires 4 cold LLM calls when cache is cold (~$$/latency). Consider gating on idle/hover.
